create_stream_logger: create a StreamLogger instance with agent_id, output_directory, and required_topics for robot data logging
start_logging_session: start a logging session on the StreamLogger with a task_id and start timestamp in nanoseconds
update_sync_and_write: update synchronization timestamps and write a protobuf message to a topic during active recording
write_sync_message: write the current time synchronization message to the sync topic during an active session
get_latest_sync_message: get a deep copy of the latest TimeSynchronization message with per-topic timestamps
